description: This file implements the SimpleBufferPool class, which manages a pool of static buffers of various sizes for efficient memory allocation and deallocation, with fallback to dynamic memory allocation when necessary.

classes.name: SimpleBufferPool
classes.description: A class that manages a pool of static buffers for efficient memory management, supporting allocation and deallocation.

methods.name: SimpleBufferPool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the static buffer pool with predefined buffer sizes and counts.

methods.name: ~SimpleBufferPool
methods.description: Destructor that releases the allocated static buffer memory.

methods.name: allocateImpl
methods.description: Allocates a buffer of at least the requested size, using static buffers if available, otherwise falling back to dynamic memory allocation.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates a buffer, returning static buffers to the pool or freeing dynamically allocated memory.
